hooks.text: 建筑不仅挡怪，还承担控场、续航与伤害职责；资源有限，地图布局本身就是武器。
hooks.excerpt: Structures aren’t just defenses - they're tactical tools for crowd control, sustain, and damage that can turn the tide of battle. But remember - your resources are limited. Build smart, and you’ll live longer.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 解锁15名以上希腊传奇幸存者，每位英雄都拥有独立的招牌能力和战斗风格。
hooks.excerpt: Unlock over 15 legendary survivors. Play as Achilles or one of a growing cast of mythical heroes, each with unique power and playstyle.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 完成挑战获取恩惠并购买永久升级，即使本轮失败也会增强下一次尝试。
hooks.excerpt: Complete challenges, earn Favors, and unlock permanent upgrades - get stronger with every attempt, even in defeat.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 写实3D画面是玩家明显偏爱的部分。
建筑玩法没有带来足够满足感。

excerpts.excerpt: the building aspect is different but it didn't really feel all that satisfying
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期地图建筑位置受限。

excerpts.excerpt: limited construction sites especially in later maps
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 多数角色缺少自动瞄准，增加不必要操作负担。

excerpts.excerpt: The lack of auto target for like 80% of the playable characters in this game really hurts it
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: the MC just felt sluggish and clunky
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 职业差异主要只是额外数值。

excerpts.excerpt: the classes are nothing more than extended bonus stats
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 希腊神话引用提升了参与感。
